authoring_basis: All 24 source rasters individually inspected at their actual rendered images. Attachment points and hem rows are explicitly game-authored choices in unchanged source-canvas pixel coordinates.
coordinate_convention: Zero-based x rightward, y downward in the source canvas. Collar point denotes center back-neck/collar seam; it is not crop top, shoulder attachment or the front V-opening tip. A compositor must explicitly map this source point to its corresponding authored target neck point.
boundaries: These records neither repair nor inherit D-068 banked body anchors.
Source hashes and dimensions describe bytes; authored coordinate integers are not anatomical measurement precision.
No fit bound, release status, rights status or visual acceptance is granted by these records.
Do not infer transparent pixels from the speckled viewer backdrop; inspect alpha separately if masking is needed.
